phase: PRECOMMITTED BEFORE READING mustRejectBy, expected, valid, bundle payloads, declared invariants, or checker derivation
method: Read only counterexampleFixtures.fixtures[].id/what and acceptingFixtures[].id/what. Independently named the violated semantic rule in reviewer-owned vocabulary. Null human descriptions were left underdetermined rather than inferred from fixture IDs or payloads.

counterexamples.rejectByReviewerInvariant: An authoritative verifiable verdict must retain evaluation-level outcome and proof material for every activated required evaluation; a label is not evidence.

An authoritative clean verdict is non-vacuous only when its declared required-evaluation universe is non-empty and exactly activated, unless the contract explicitly proves that an empty universe is the intended policy.
A no-match/absence claim requires retained complete-universe proof or an offline regeneration closure; a subject-set digest alone cannot prove non-membership after both are gone.
Evidence obligation and locality are host-resolved from the predicate/claim semantics; a producer may not self-downgrade a relationship result to a weaker local obligation.

Retention closure is referentially intact: evidence reachable from a retained authoritative Run cannot be garbage-collected without a recorded retention-state transition that changes the Run's assurance status.
Storage root, privacy class, and retention policy must be resolved before the first durable source-derived write.
Replayable means the complete historical producer/toolchain and required environment closure is available offline; missing any required member forbids the replayable label.
The authoritative verdict is a total fold of required evaluation outcomes; any required indeterminate outcome prevents a clean pass even when receipts are structurally present.
A sample can witness presence but cannot establish absence; absence requires complete subject-universe coverage or an appropriate complete non-membership proof.
The activated required-evaluation set must exactly equal the resolved declared universe; neither silent omission nor undeclared addition is acceptable.

acceptingFixtures.acceptanceRule: Accept only if the authoritative pass has a non-empty exactly activated universe, every required evaluation folds to pass, and every no-match claim has retained complete-universe proof or offline regeneration closure.
No human what prose was present, so acceptance cannot be independently derived without violating the blind protocol.
Accept when the same required indeterminate evaluation that invalidates RA-CE-7 is preserved and the Run verdict is honestly indeterminate rather than pass.
Accept thin evidence only when the Run is explicitly advisory/non-authoritative and cannot be consumed as an authoritative attestation.
No human what prose was present, so acceptance and the contents of the claimed closure cannot be independently derived without inspecting forbidden fields.
